snippet.title: Dog in the Machine - Gameplay Reveal | Tactical Deckbuilder Roguelite
snippet.description:
Wishlist Dog in the Machine on Steam now! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4613180/Dog_in_the_Machine/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_description&utm_campaign=trailer_launch

ADAPT. COMBINE. ESCAPE.
Help an AutoDog fight his way out of a dystopian mecha-city to reunite with his exiled humans in Dog in the Machine, a new grid-based tactical roguelite!

💥 Chain-Reaction Gameplay: Engage in combat on compact grids filled with conveyor belts, explosive obstacles, and interactive buttons. Trigger satisfying domino effects to destroy your enemies in spectacular ways!

🧠 Tactical Without the Headache: Thanks to a real-time preview system, you can test and tweak your moves before committing. No cognitive overload—just pure, experimental strategy.

🃏 Dual-Layered Deckbuilding: Teach your dog new Tricks after every battle. Combine them freely to invent powerful synergies and create your own unique playstyle.

If you lose, it’s not a careless mistake, it’s an opportunity to build a better strategy.

#DogInTheMachine #TacticalRoguelite #Deckbuilder #IndieGame #Roguelike
